Use ir_spectra tool. That will give IR peaks; carbonyl around 1700 cm-1. Count number of distinct carbonyl peaks. Could be ambiguous. Better to get carbon NMR: carbonyl carbons appear ~190-210 ppm. Count number of signals in that region. Use carbon_nmr_spectra. Let's do that.
